---
title: Player contributions
---

Contribution measures assign value to performances in completed matches. The
initial candidate is ball-level batting and bowling value that accounts for runs,
wickets, and the state of the innings. Win probability added will provide a
separate account of how much events changed a team's chances in their actual
match context.

**Validated contribution estimates are not yet available.** The
[exploratory WAR results](https://github.com/outside-edge/player_value/tree/main/experiments/war)
use assumptions that still require calibration. They are not current rankings.

WAR requires both a replacement baseline and a defensible conversion to expected
wins. An average player is not necessarily a replacement player. The baseline
must reflect an available substitute appropriate to the role and competition.

Season and career totals will be accompanied by an explicitly defined rate
measure and exposure. Different units, such as runs above replacement and win
probability added, will remain separate. Batting, bowling, and fielding credit
cannot simply be added if their attribution rules count the same event twice.

Detailed fielding opportunities are not available in the current data. Any total
player measure must disclose what fielding contribution it can and cannot capture.
